description: Classes of material a part may be made of — the values of a manifest's requirements.materials.any_of / none_of, solid and soft. A class names the material, not a product: each one lists the commons' material cards that belong to it (yantra4d cards for solids, Fashion Cabinet fabric cards for the six fabric classes) and, where those cards record one, their EMMO class.

review.note: Key set, cross-maps, labels and definitions drafted in one pass by an agent (P3-LEX lane, 2026-10-02) against SEM-1 §4. No language facet of any entry has had a native review: every entry says `generated`, and Spanish is the bar a reviewer should read first. Facts were checked against the cited sources on the access date; no ruling has been made by a human.

definition.en: Polylactic acid: a stiff, easy-to-print thermoplastic filament with low heat resistance.

definition.fr: Acide polylactique : filament thermoplastique rigide et facile à imprimer, peu résistant à la chaleur.
definition.pt: Ácido polilático: filamento termoplástico rígido e fácil de imprimir, com baixa resistência ao calor.
